name: brick-mosaic
title: Brick Mosaic
description: Toy bricks drop in row by row from the bottom with a small bounce and build a pixel-art image on a baseplate. Give it a pixel-art grid as text in the pattern variable, or leave it empty for a built-in red disc.
useWhen: A logo, icon or emoji should be built out of toy bricks, one row at a time, for a playful reveal.
The image is simple enough to read as pixel art on a grid of about 10 to 40 cells across.
A kids, gaming or maker-themed video needs a build moment that feels hands-on.
avoidWhen: The mark should assemble from a few geometric pieces that spin and snap into place: use puzzle-snap.
The build should rise as an isometric 3D city rather than a flat mosaic: use isometric-build.
The scene should melt into pixel streaks as a transition: use pixel-sort.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Pattern
variables.description: Pixel art as text: rows separated by / , one character per cell. Characters are looked up in Colors; unknown characters and spaces leave the cell empty. Empty builds the default disc.

variables.label: Colors
variables.description: JSON map from pattern character to a CSS color.

variables.label: Columns
variables.description: Grid columns of the default disc.

variables.label: Rows
variables.description: Grid rows of the default disc.
